changeSet.author: landvault
changeSet.sql:
ALTER TABLE estate_default_terms ADD COLUMN penalties_refundable boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true; COMMENT ON COLUMN estate_default_terms.penalties_refundable IS 'Declared by the developer: whether late-payment penalties are returned, on the refund terms, to a buyer who withdraws. Refundable penalties are held in escrow like the instalment; others are paid out to the developer in full.';
-- Appended at the end, so CREATE OR REPLACE keeps the view and its grants. CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW marketplace_default_terms WITH (security_barrier = true) AS SELECT DISTINCT ON (d.estate_id) d.id AS default_terms_id, d.estate_id AS estate_id, d.revocation_trigger AS revocation_trigger, d.revocation_notice_days AS revocation_notice_days, d.on_revocation_refund AS on_revocation_refund, d.development_deadline_months AS development_deadline_months, d.transfer_requires_consent AS transfer_requires_consent, d.notes AS notes, d.penalties_refundable AS penalties_refundable FROM estate_default_terms d JOIN marketplace_estate_eligibility el ON el.estate_id = d.estate_id AND el.eligible WHERE d.deleted = false ORDER BY d.estate_id, d.version DESC;
changeSet.rollback: DROP VIEW marketplace_penalty_tiers; DROP VIEW marketplace_default_terms; CREATE VIEW marketplace_default_terms WITH (security_barrier = true) AS SELECT DISTINCT ON (d.estate_id) d.id AS default_terms_id, d.estate_id AS estate_id, d.revocation_trigger AS revocation_trigger, d.revocation_notice_days AS revocation_notice_days, d.on_revocation_refund AS on_revocation_refund, d.development_deadline_months AS development_deadline_months, d.transfer_requires_consent AS transfer_requires_consent, d.notes AS notes FROM estate_default_terms d JOIN marketplace_estate_eligibility el ON el.estate_id = d.estate_id AND el.eligible WHERE d.deleted = false ORDER BY d.estate_id, d.version DESC; CREATE VIEW marketplace_penalty_tiers WITH (security_barrier = true) AS SELECT t.id AS penalty_tier_id, d.estate_id AS estate_id, t.months_late AS months_late, t.penalty_pct AS penalty_pct FROM estate_default_penalty_tiers t JOIN marketplace_default_terms d ON d.default_terms_id = t.default_terms_id WHERE t.deleted = false; REVOKE ALL ON marketplace_default_terms, marketplace_penalty_tiers FROM PUBLIC; REVOKE ALL ON marketplace_default_terms, marketplace_penalty_tiers FROM ${appDbUsername}; GRANT SELECT ON marketplace_default_terms, marketplace_penalty_tiers TO ${appDbUsername}; ALTER TABLE estate_default_terms DROP COLUMN penalties_refundable;
